patches.text: 視程（visibility：目立つ物を見分けられる距離。米国） ｜ 法定マイル（SM：statute mile） ｜ 1 SM ＝ 5,280 ft ≈ 1.609 km ｜
patches.source: NIST SP 811 Appendix B.9（https://www.nist.gov/pml/special-publication-811/nist-guide-si-appendix-b-conversion-factors/nist-guide-si-appendix-b9。2026-10-27 に読んだ）：foot → m 0.3048（正確）、mile → km 1.609344（正確）、nautical mile → m 1852（正確）、mi/h → km/h 1.609344（正確）、gal (U.S.) → L 3.785412、inch of mercury, conventional → Pa 3386.389、t/°C ＝（t/°F − 32）/1.8（32 と 1.8 は正確）。lb の正確な値 0.45359237 kg は同じ付録の脚注 22。視程の意味は FAA Pilot/Controller Glossary の VISIBILITY（https://www.faa.gov/air_traffic/publications/atpubs/pcg_html/glossary-v.html。revise-basics が 2026-10-27 に読んだ）：The ability … to see and identify prominent unlighted objects by day and prominent lighted objects by night. Visibility is reported as statute miles
